picks.title: 要去什麼地方
picks.highlight: 田馥甄时隔多年回归全新专辑，以细腻声线探讨人生去向与自我和解，台式流行的一次优雅升华。
picks.highlightEn: Hebe Tien's long-awaited return explores life's direction with her delicate voice—an elegant step forward for Taiwanese pop.
picks.summary: 台湾金曲歌后全新专辑，延续空灵嗓音与细腻叙事，主题围绕人生方向与自我对话。
picks.summaryEn: A new album from Taiwan's award-winning diva, continuing her ethereal vocals and introspective storytelling about direction and self.

picks.title: PINK TAPE
picks.highlight: 韩国嘻哈厂牌H1GHR MUSIC集结旗下Rapper的合辑，Groovy律动与强势说唱轮番登场。
picks.highlightEn: A label compilation from Korean hip-hop crew H1GHR MUSIC, packed with groove-heavy beats and fierce verses.
picks.summary: 韩国嘻哈厂牌合辑，融合说唱与韩式流行，节奏强劲，展现新生代Rapper实力。
picks.summaryEn: A Korean hip-hop label compilation blending rap with K-pop polish, showcasing a rising generation of rappers.

picks.title: Snow, Vol. 9
picks.highlight: 德国Lo-Fi制作人Wun Two雪季系列第九辑，暖噪点与轻柔节拍伴你缓缓入冬。
picks.highlightEn: German lo-fi producer Wun Two's ninth Snow volume—warm tape hiss and gentle beats for easing into winter.
picks.summary: Lo-Fi嘻哈代表制作人雪季系列新作，慵懒采样与柔和鼓点，适合学习与放松。
picks.summaryEn: A new entry in the flagship lo-fi hip-hop producer's Snow series: lazy samples and soft drums for study and chill.

picks.title: Mr. Rock Steady
picks.highlight: 牙买加摇滚steady传奇Ken Boothe新作，醇厚嗓音重现六十年代复古浪漫情怀。
picks.highlightEn: Jamaican rocksteady legend Ken Boothe returns, his velvet voice reviving 1960s romantic soul.
picks.summary: 牙买加摇滚steady元老全新专辑，复古灵魂唱腔与轻松律动，雷鬼乐迷必听。
picks.summaryEn: A new album from a rocksteady founding father: vintage soulful vocals and easy grooves, essential for reggae fans.

picks.title: Future Soul
picks.highlight: 夫妻档布鲁斯摇滚天团新专辑，双吉他即兴与灵魂嗓音交织出炙热现场感。
picks.highlightEn: The husband-wife blues-rock powerhouse returns with fiery dual-guitar improvisation and soulful vocals.
picks.summary: 美国布鲁斯摇滚大团新作，融合灵魂乐与南方摇滚，器乐演奏水准极高。
picks.summaryEn: A new record from a major American blues-rock band, blending soul and Southern rock with elite musicianship.

picks.title: Big Cock
picks.highlight: 英国Psychobilly老牌乐队复出专辑，狂野摇滚与怪诞幽默一触即发。
picks.highlightEn: British psychobilly veterans return with wild rockabilly energy and gleefully absurd humor.
picks.summary: 英国Psychobilly乐队新专辑，融合摇滚abilly与朋克，节奏癫狂充满戏剧性。
picks.summaryEn: A UK psychobilly band's new album mixing rockabilly with punk—manic rhythms and theatrical flair.

picks.title: Fantasy
picks.highlight: 神秘英国制作人长篇浩室拼贴专辑，采样编织出梦幻而超现实的舞池旅程。
picks.highlightEn: The mysterious UK producer's sprawling house opus collages samples into a dreamlike, surreal dancefloor trip.
picks.summary: 英国匿名制作人作品，融合浩室与拼贴采样，氛围梦幻，长篇幅极具沉浸感。
picks.summaryEn: An anonymous UK producer fusing house with plunderphonic sampling—dreamy and deeply immersive at length.

picks.title: PHASE I : Soft Violence
picks.highlight: 泰民新专辑以柔和与暴烈并置，极致编舞感与暗黑流行美学全面升级。
picks.highlightEn: Taemin's new album pairs softness with violence, elevating his dark pop aesthetic and choreography-driven sound.
picks.summary: 韩国顶级SOLO艺人泰民全新专辑，暗黑流行与R&B融合，制作精良表演性极强。
picks.summaryEn: Korea's top solo artist returns with dark pop and R&B, immaculately produced and highly performative.

picks.title: snowfall
picks.highlight: 匿名制作人的氛围篇章，如雪落无声，冷冽合成器铺陈出静谧冬日图景。
picks.highlightEn: An anonymous producer's ambient chapter—silent as falling snow, cold synths painting a quiet winter scene.
picks.summary: 氛围电子专辑，以冷色调合成器与大量留白营造冬日静谧感，适合深夜聆听。
picks.summaryEn: An ambient electronic album using cold synths and open space to evoke a hushed winter, best heard late at night.

picks.title: Nothing Hurts Like Everything
picks.highlight: 加拿大独立音乐人新作，用低调编曲包裹心碎情绪，温柔而克制。
picks.highlightEn: A Canadian indie artist wraps heartbreak in understated arrangements—tender, restrained and quietly moving.
picks.summary: 加拿大独立摇滚专辑，情绪内敛，旋律优美，编曲简约而富有感染力。
picks.summaryEn: A Canadian indie rock album: reserved emotion, lovely melodies and simple yet affecting arrangements.

picks.title: THE PROTÉGÉ
picks.highlight: 香港新生代唱作人首张专辑，R&B与粤语流行碰撞，唱出都市青年的心声。
picks.highlightEn: A Hong Kong singer-songwriter's debut blends R&B with Cantopop, voicing the dreams of city youth.
picks.summary: 香港新生代创作歌手专辑，融合R&B与粤语流行，旋律流畅，唱功扎实。
picks.summaryEn: A new-generation Hong Kong singer-songwriter's album blending R&B and Cantopop with smooth hooks and solid vocals.

picks.title: Heiß/Kalt
picks.highlight: 德国创作女声EP，冷热交替的情绪张力，德语流行鲜锐又现代的表达。
picks.highlightEn: A German singer-songwriter's EP swinging between hot and cold—a sharp, modern voice in German pop.
picks.summary: 德国流行女歌手EP，电子编曲与德语歌词结合，情绪起伏鲜明，风格现代。
picks.summaryEn: A German pop EP pairing electronic production with German lyrics, marked by vivid emotional swings.

picks.title: Labor of Love
picks.highlight: 布鲁斯吉他老将回归，炙热推弦与沧桑嗓音，献给热爱与坚持的灵魂。
picks.highlightEn: A veteran blues guitarist returns with scorching bends and a weathered voice—a true labor of love.
picks.summary: 美国布鲁斯吉他名家新专辑，传统蓝调与摇滚结合，吉他演奏醇熟动人。
picks.summaryEn: An American blues guitar master's new album, joining traditional blues with rock and seasoned playing.

picks.title: Appalachia
picks.highlight: 阿巴拉契亚山脉孕育的民谣叙事，女声温柔讲述土地、信仰与离别。
picks.highlightEn: Folk storytelling born of the Appalachian hills—a gentle voice on land, faith and farewells.
picks.summary: 美国民谣创作女歌手专辑，叙事性强，弦乐与和声温暖，乡土气息浓郁。
picks.summaryEn: An American folk songwriter's album: strongly narrative, warm strings and harmonies, rich in rural atmosphere.

picks.title: The Lighthouse Session II
picks.highlight: 厄运金属名团灯塔现场第二章，沉重riff与钢琴交织出悲怆诗意。
picks.highlightEn: A doom metal institution's second lighthouse session—crushing riffs woven with piano into mournful poetry.
picks.summary: 厄运金属乐队现场EP，旋律忧郁，吉他厚重，钢琴点缀营造出史诗氛围。
picks.summaryEn: A doom metal live EP: mournful melodies, thick guitars and piano accents building an epic atmosphere.
